title: Output on a matched decision path
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $T$ be a decision tree on the binary cube $ br^n$ with outputs in a type $\alpha$, and let $f:\bbr^n\to\alpha$ be the function computed by $T$. If $P$ is one of the paths of $T$ and $x\in\bbr^n$ agrees with every coordinate value assigned along $P$, then $f(x)$ equals the output label at the terminal leaf of $P$.
